div.div: طُرْآنٌ , (O, K,) or ↓ طُرْآنِىٌّ , occurring in the poetry of El-'Ajjáj, (TA,) A road, or way, and an affair, or event, unknown, or disapproved, or deemed strange or extraordinary: (O, K:) [or an affair, or event,] unknown, &c., and wonderful. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
